notes.title: Zombie Tower Survivor – Demo Update for Debut Festival 2025
notes.notes:
Zombie Tower Survivor is featured in Debut Festival 2025! 🎉



We’ve released a demo update to celebrate, with new content, quality-of-life improvements, and balance tweaks.


What’s new in the demo v0.4.1.0:
Game settings menu, including fullscreen/windowed toggle and more

Custom spawn speed to control how fast enemies appear (replaced the option for adjusting game speed)

New Aspect: Hippo

Tutorial part 1 for new players (someone cute and fluffy will be there to help 😉)

DoT & Penetration talent rebalance

Tower level preview in shop

Real-time updates of stats

Bug fixes, such as infinite rerolls in the shop and achievements not saving correctly

...and other under-the-hood improvements
Try out the updated demo: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3476900/Zombie_Tower_Survivor_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]
If you enjoy Zombie Tower Survivor, please leave a review and wishlist the game! It helps a ton. 🧟
